Age and frontal cortical location introduce uncertainty for IDH and 1p/19q, but the marked enhancement, necrosis, edema, mass effect, deep white-matter and ependymal invasion strongly favor an aggressive IDH-wildtype, non-codeleted grade 4 glioma phenotype. Molecular testing remains required for definitive WHO CNS5 classification.
